lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in roughly 10-12 identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with inter-centroid spacing approximately 1.5 to 2.5 times the mean blob diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary lateral blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light upper surfaces to shadowed lower surfaces, running parallel to the primary axis of the body.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 6-8 distinct, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily in the lower two-thirds of the visible fin area.

other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge of the pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of small-diameter spots, significantly more compact than the patterning observed on the central lateral flank.
